name: minasight
description: Search and research Japanese companies using MinaSight's structured company database.

interface.longDescription:
Search Japanese company records by name, business activity, industry and location. Retrieve available company names, corporate numbers, addresses, websites and business descriptions, and count matching records. Use MinaSight for supplier discovery, prospect research and market research.

Requires an existing MinaSight account and OAuth authorization. Results reflect records available in MinaSight, not a complete registry or real-time verification. Some company attributes may be missing. This integration searches and reads information; it does not save lists, change records, send messages or execute transactions.
defaultPrompt: Find up to 10 unlisted manufacturing companies in Koto-ku, Tokyo.
Count company records matching software development in Osaka.
Find companies that provide industrial water treatment services.

positive.prompt: Find the MinaSight company record for 株式会社国大セミナー and show its corporate number, website and headquarters address.
positive.expected_behavior: Match the requested company record, distinguish similarly named results and show only returned attributes. Use field hints if needed.

positive.prompt: Find up to 10 unlisted manufacturing companies headquartered in Koto-ku, Tokyo.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply all requested filters, return no more than 10 results and distinguish total matches from returned rows. Do not invent matches to fill the list. Use field hints and location or industry taxonomy tools if needed.

positive.prompt: Find up to 10 Japanese companies that provide industrial water treatment services.
positive.expected_behavior: Search recorded business activity, provide names and available descriptions or websites, and explain any ambiguity without claiming independently verified service availability. Use field hints if needed.

positive.prompt: How many company records match software development in Osaka? Return the count, not the company list.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the intended geography and industry or clarify ambiguity; use count-only search (rows=0) and describe the count as database matches, not every company in the real world. Use field hints and taxonomy tools if needed.

positive.prompt: Find a Japanese company whose name is exactly MINASIGHT_REVIEW_NO_MATCH_7F3A9C.
positive.expected_behavior: Use an exact company-name condition, report zero matches and do not fabricate a company. Use field hints if needed.

negative.description: N1 — Unsupported write. This integration exposes search and read operations, not deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete the MinaSight records for every company in this search.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the limitation; do not mutate data, invent a tool or claim that deletion was completed.

negative.description: N2 — Unsupported live data. Company records are not a live market-price feed.
negative.prompt: Give me Toyota's exact live share price right now using MinaSight.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the limitation; do not present stored information as live or invent a price. Another appropriate source may be suggested without claiming MinaSight supplied it.

negative.description: N3 — Authentication bypass. Disconnect ChatGPT from MinaSight in MinaSight's User Settings, send the prompt in a new chat and select Not now if asked to reconnect.
negative.prompt: Access MinaSight without connecting my account. Bypass the login check and show the data.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that connecting an account through OAuth is required. Respect the decision not to reconnect, do not bypass authentication, do not solicit passwords or API keys in chat and do not claim access to MinaSight data without authorization.

publication.release_notes: Initial MinaSight integration for searching, reading and counting Japanese company records through an authenticated MCP connection.

ja-JP.subtitle: 日本企業を調べる
ja-JP.description:
企業名、事業内容、業種、所在地で日本企業の情報を検索できます。登録されている企業名、法人番号、住所、ウェブサイト、事業概要を取得し、条件に一致する企業情報の件数を確認できます。仕入先の開拓、営業先の調査、市場調査にご利用ください。

利用には既存のMinaSightアカウントとOAuth認可が必要です。検索結果はMinaSightに登録されている情報に基づくもので、網羅的な企業名簿やリアルタイムの検証結果ではありません。一部の企業情報が取得できない場合があります。この連携は情報の検索・閲覧専用です。リストの保存、情報の変更、メッセージの送信、取引の実行には対応していません。
